topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I found it, a space tucked away, forgotten or perhaps deliberately concealed. Dust whispers the age of secrets, shadows pooling in the corners where light dares not tread. The walls, they stand as silent sentinels, guarding tales untold. Each step feels heavier than the last, the silence pressing in, a weight that bends my shoulders. What lies within these walls? Artefacts of a past life, echoes of footsteps long silent. The air grows thicker, each breath a struggle. I must know, yet part of me screams to turn away, to leave the past buried. But curiosity, a relentless beast, drives me forward, deeper into the heart of what was hidden.
